teaser: secrets.sgit.ai becomes a service for moving a secret from A to B on public keys only: no shared keys, a vault for the private key, eight scenarios.
core_idea: secrets.sgit.ai, a site whose app was never built but whose design already shares secrets through key pairs, a directory and inboxes, becomes a commercial service for moving secrets from A to B; shared keys are dropped because the easy two-word codes were found broken, recoverable offline from their public id; every person, browser and agent gets a key pair, the public key travels by link, QR code, email or WhatsApp, secrets come back encrypted as one-time drops, files or QR codes, and the private key lives in an identity vault unlocked by a passkey that a password manager keeps; most plumbing exists in SG/Send, append lanes and sgit pki, and the capabilities, not the transport, are what is charged for.
